name: Menu
description: A structured action menu with keyboard navigation, disabled items, icons, and danger styling.
usage:
<Menu
  trigger={<IconButton label="Project actions"><MoreVertical /></IconButton>}
  items={[
    { id: 'settings', label: 'Settings', onSelect: () => undefined },
    { id: 'archive', label: 'Archive', variant: 'danger', onSelect: () => undefined },
  ]}
/>

anatomy.description: The element that opens the menu; give icon-only triggers an accessible label via IconButton.
The floating list that follows the menu pattern with roving highlight and typeahead.
One action with a label, optional leading icon, disabled state, and a danger variant.
A hairline inserted with separatorBefore to group related actions and isolate destructive ones.

dos: Group related actions with separatorBefore and put destructive items last with the danger variant.
Keep labels short and verb-led, like "Duplicate" or "Export as PDF".
Disable unavailable items instead of hiding them so the menu stays stable.
donts: Don't hide frequently used primary actions behind a menu; keep them visible.
Don't use a menu for navigation links; use NavigationMenu or plain links instead.
Don't open dialogs from a menu item without closing the menu first (onSelect handles this).

examples.title: Keyboard action menu

guidance.useWhen: Several related actions belong behind one trigger.
guidance.avoidWhen: The actions should remain visible for frequent workflows.
guidance.behavior: Keyboard navigation and dismissal are managed by Radix.
guidance.responsive: Keep destructive actions separated and easy to reach on touch.

keyboard.action: Opens the menu and highlights the first item.
Opens the menu and highlights the last item.
Moves the highlight between items, skipping disabled ones.
Highlights the first or last item.
Typeahead jumps to the first matching item.
Activates the highlighted item and closes the menu.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.

notes: Renders the ARIA menu pattern with menuitem roles and roving highlight.
Icons are decorative; every item keeps a text label.
Set modal to trap focus and block outside interaction while the menu is open.
